title: SPINO: Software for exoPlanet vIsibility and Nightly Observations
description: SPINO is a self-contained Tkinter desktop application for planning exoplanet transit and secondary-eclipse phase-coverage observations. It wraps a scientific scheduling pipeline (catalog loading, desert filtering, per-planet visibility computation, TSM/ESM ranking, telluric-overlap plots) behind an editable graphical interface, so that every scheduling parameter is a form field rather than a line in a configuration file.
